task.ques: Plot Albert Einstein curve with Parametric equations.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Plotted the first Albert Einstein curve parametrically on WolframAlpha, for t from 0 to 92π.

Evidence: final.png shows “first Albert Einstein curve,” the “parametric equations” input interpretation, the complete Einstein portrait plot, and its parameter range. WolframAlpha did not display the explicit x(t) and y(t) formulas.

Source: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=Albert+Einstein+curve+parametric+equations
